text: {"lessons":["I should judge each holding by its current merits, not by its purchase price or reluctance to acknowledge a mistake.","The swings so far offer no reliable signal about next month's prices, so I should not chase recent gains or sell solely because of recent declines.","Because I check infrequently and rarely trade, I should make deliberate decisions based on my goals and risk tolerance rather than react to short-term account changes."]}
